exists.note: Windows 10 and Windows 11; Microsoft lists Enterprise, Education and Pro Education/SE as supported editions. Editions are not modelled here: on other editions CRED-07 fails as not running.

capabilities.note: Hardware requirements (64-bit CPU with virtualization extensions, SLAT) are not modelled; the runtime state decides.
Win32_DeviceGuard exists on Windows 10, Windows 11 and Windows Server 2016 and later; hardware readiness is not modelled.
Memory integrity (hypervisor-protected code integrity) on Windows 10, Windows 11 and Windows Server 2016 and later.
Added LSA protection exists on Windows 8.1 and Windows Server 2012 R2 and later (build 9600).
